objective: Resolve all seven exposed pi-to-pi transitions with a uniform response-consistent selected-configuration model, preserving n-to-pi controls.
reference: Same retained native GFN2 orbitals and frozen CAM-derived common F/Q reference as the twenty-state test.
first_candidate: Use the native functional's nearest Pauli-compatible charge/spin two-body response and consistently normal-ordered one-body operator in the selected optimized-target-plus-doubles space. Preserve every native diagonal functional and exact four-spin block; retain moving stationary-ground projection.
motivation: The previous kernel-response tests used the enlarged canonical-singles diagnostic space, whereas the selected-CID success omitted unoptimized canonical singles. Test their physically consistent combination before changing any functional or parameter.
selection: Every molecule receives identical algebra; use the unchanged selected-space indices and wavefunction assignment gates. No reference-energy root matching.
exposure: All twenty target energies are exposed development; no blind validation claim.
compute: Verified Oracle or MAC-STUDIO only; all prepared references, states and completed operator/matrix checkpoints are reused.

subsequent_diagnostics.name: native_reanchor
subsequent_diagnostics.hypothesis: Kernel evaluated at native GFN2 ground density rather than embedded DFT density; preserve the same first derivative and F/Q levels. Fixed-orbital diagnostic precedes any new stationarity claim.

subsequent_diagnostics.name: nonlinear_xc
subsequent_diagnostics.hypothesis: Measure exact CAM-B3LYP XC remainder beyond the quadratic native-density expansion on archived OO states. This diagnostic is not an energy correction selected from labels.

subsequent_diagnostics.name: density_driven
subsequent_diagnostics.hypothesis: Test the published ensemble ddA algebra as a matrix functional before diagonalization, with external xi=.32. Combining it with the existing native functional is exploratory and is not GX24.

subsequent_diagnostics.name: screened_ensemble
subsequent_diagnostics.hypothesis: Replace bare transition self interaction by constrained-screened interaction in the exploratory ddA matrix; same xi=.32, no refit. This is not the published GX24 functional.

subsequent_diagnostics.name: expanded_cid
subsequent_diagnostics.hypothesis: Test uniform active-space completeness with all rank-two singlet CSFs from three highest occupied and three lowest virtual native orbitals; exclude their entire product from environmental screening. Retain optimized target singles and paired doubles. No new empirical parameter.
subsequent_diagnostics.regression: At m=2 reproduce the completed constrained-screened selected-CID Furan result before running m=3.
subsequent_diagnostics.selection: One common active size for every molecule; no per-molecule choice and no nuclear derivative claim before completing the new response algebra.
